program.section_heading: MC3 Pre-Apprenticeship Employment Ready, Certificate of Achievement - Major #9244
outcomes: Prepare students with pre-apprenticeship introductory skills, experiences, and nine units of work experience necessary to apply for an apprenticeship as a Sheet Metal Worker, Ironworker, Plumber/Pipefitter, Painter, Mason, Electrician or Teamster.

notes: The catalog prints no heading for the course list; the block name 'Required Courses' is supplied. All three courses are listed without a choice rule and sum to the printed Total : 16, so they are read as all required.

AT 19 is printed with 9 units, while the state file stores 1 unit; the outcome mentions nine units of work experience (description says 2 semesters), so AT 19 is likely variable/repeatable work experience taken for 9 units.
PREAPP 120 and PREAPP 121 are not in the closed list and are recorded as catalog additions.
The source URL path references the 2025-2026 FCC Catalog under a 2026-27 programs alias; reviewer may confirm catalog year.

Careers include the trades named in the description ('Ironworkers. Masons' printed with a period typo), 'Plumber/Pipefitter' from the outcome, and trades introduced via guest speakers (Carpenter, Drywaller/Latherer, Insulator, Laborer, Roofer/Water Proofer); the guest-speaker trades are named as other trades students may be introduced to, not as direct program targets.
